notes.title: Achievements unlocked for Linux
notes.notes: Dear Linux friends, Achievements now work also for Linux

notes.title: Linux release now available!
notes.notes: We have now released Fruit Tower Defense for Linux! :)

notes.title: Game difficulty update
notes.notes: Based on feedback received from players, we how updated the game difficulty by making the Easy option easier and Hard option more difficult. So there is now a bigger difference in difficulty depending on game option chosen.
